sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，在加利福尼亚州的一处葡萄园内发现了一具女性尸体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首，且体内的血液已被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽了心思来隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，人们只知道她叫无名氏。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 随后，侦探们终于得知了她的名字——艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但是，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“档案档案呈献”推出的全新系列，各大播客平台现已上线。

sentences.en: Tom had approached on Thanksgiving Eve, November 23rd, 2016.
sentences.zh: 汤姆是在感恩节前夕，即2016年11月23日走近的。

sentences.en: Penny Meek was up waiting for her son, Tom Brown, who was due home any moment.
sentences.zh: 佩妮·米克正醒着等待她的儿子汤姆·布朗，他随时都该回家了。

sentences.en: Hours earlier, Tom had gone out to meet up with friends.
sentences.zh: 几个小时前，汤姆出门去和朋友们见面了。

sentences.en: The 18-year-old had a strict midnight curfew and was rarely late.
sentences.zh: 这位18岁的小伙子有着严格的午夜宵禁规定，极少迟到。

sentences.en: If he was, he always got in touch to let his mother know.
sentences.zh: 如果迟到了，他总是会联系母亲告知一声。

sentences.en: So far, she'd heard nothing.
sentences.zh: 然而到目前为止，她什么消息也没收到。

sentences.en: Tucker Brown, Tom's older brother, was home from Oklahoma State University for Thanksgiving.
sentences.zh: 塔克·布朗是汤姆的哥哥，为了过感恩节从俄克拉荷马州立大学回到家中。

sentences.en: Earlier that night, Tucker caught his younger brother as he was leaving.
sentences.zh: 那天早些时候，塔克在弟弟出门时抓了个正着。

sentences.en: Wanting to spend some quality time, Tucker suggested they should watch a movie together later that night.
sentences.zh: 为了享受一段美好的共处时光，塔克提议他们那天晚些时候一起看部电影。

sentences.en: Tom happily agreed.
sentences.zh: 汤姆欣然同意了。

sentences.en: Midnight ticked by, and there was no sign of Tom.
sentences.zh: 午夜悄然过去，却不见汤姆的踪影。

sentences.en: At 12.03am, Tucker sent his brother a text, asking where he was.
sentences.zh: 凌晨12点03分，塔克给弟弟发了一条信息，询问他在哪里。

sentences.en: Tom didn't reply.
sentences.zh: 汤姆没有回复。

sentences.en: Tucker and Penny sent Tom several more text messages, trying to locate him.
sentences.zh: 塔克和佩妮又给汤姆发送了好几条短信，试图确定他的位置。

sentences.en: But still, they received a no response.
sentences.zh: 但他们依然没有收到任何回复。

sentences.en: This was unusual.
sentences.zh: 这很不寻常。

sentences.en: Tom always responded to texts.
sentences.zh: 汤姆总是会回复短信。

sentences.en: At 12.23am, Penny tried to call Tom.
sentences.zh: 凌晨12点23分，佩妮试图给汤姆打电话。

sentences.en: But her call went straight to voicemail.
sentences.zh: 但她的电话直接转入了语音信箱。

sentences.en: His phone was off.
sentences.zh: 他的手机关机了。

sentences.en: Penny's concern grew.
sentences.zh: 佩妮的担忧加剧了。

sentences.en: Though Tom could be a joker and a goofball, he wasn't the type to pull a prank like this.
sentences.zh: 尽管汤姆有时会开玩笑、耍宝，但他并不是那种会搞这种恶作剧的人。

sentences.en: He was a well-behaved son, far from rebellious or disrespectful.
sentences.zh: 他是一个乖巧的儿子，绝不叛逆或无礼。

sentences.en: Tom preferred playing video games with friends than going to wild parties.
sentences.zh: 汤姆宁愿和朋友们打电子游戏，也不愿去参加狂野的派对。

sentences.en: It was strikingly out of character for him to miss curfew and not be in touch.
sentences.zh: 错过宵禁且失联，这与他的性格大相径庭。

sentences.en: Penny feared Tom had been in a car accident.
sentences.zh: 佩妮担心汤姆出了车祸。

sentences.en: Getting into separate cars to cover more ground, Penny and Tucker went searching for Tom's red-coloured 2009 Dodge Durango SUV.
sentences.zh: 佩妮和塔克分别开着车去扩大搜寻范围，寻找汤姆那辆红色的2009款道奇杜兰戈SUV。

sentences.en: The pair turned down the suburban streets of their small, North Texan town of Canadian, population just over two and a half thousand people.
sentences.zh: 两人拐入了他们位于得克萨斯州北部小镇卡纳迪安的郊区街道，这里的人口刚刚超过两千五百人。

sentences.en: The quaint, country-style homes were dark and quiet.
sentences.zh: 古朴的乡村风格住宅漆黑而安静。

sentences.en: Families had settled in ahead of the following day's festivities.
sentences.zh: 为了迎接次日的庆祝活动，家家户户都已经安顿下来。

sentences.en: The main street was equally still and silent.
sentences.zh: 主街道同样静谧无声。

sentences.en: Penny and Tucker combed the entire town, checking local haunts and hangouts.
sentences.zh: 佩妮和塔克搜遍了整个小镇，检查了当地的常去地点和聚会场所。

sentences.en: Yet, there was no sign of Tom or his car.
sentences.zh: 然而，不见汤姆或他汽车的踪影。

sentences.en: Though Canadian has more wealth and bustle than other townships in the semi-arid panhandle region of Texas, it was still incredibly small and close-knit.
sentences.zh: 尽管卡纳迪安比得克萨斯州半干旱狭长地带的其他城镇更富裕、更热闹，但它依然小得难以置信，且邻里关系紧密。

sentences.en: The layout of the land is deeply ingrained within the residents who live there.
sentences.zh: 这里的地形布局早已深深印在当地居民的脑海中。

sentences.en: There's no way Tom was loSt.
sentences.zh: 汤姆绝不可能迷路。

sentences.en: Penny returned home to start making calls.
sentences.zh: 佩妮返回家中开始打电话。

sentences.en: Tom had gone out that night to meet with Caleb and another friend, Christian Webb.
sentences.zh: 汤姆那天晚上出门是去见迦勒和另一个朋友克里斯蒂安·韦布。

sentences.en: All three were long-time friends from Canadian high school.
sentences.zh: 这三人都是卡纳迪安高中的老朋友。

sentences.en: Christian was now a freshman at Oklahoma State University, and like Tom's older brother Tucker, she was back home in Canadian for Thanksgiving break.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂安现在是俄克拉荷马州立大学的一名大一新生，和汤姆的哥哥塔克一样，她也是回卡纳迪安过感恩节假期的。

sentences.en: With Christian in town, the group decided to perform an old ritual.
sentences.zh: 随着克里斯蒂安回到镇上，大家决定重温一个老传统。

sentences.en: Go for a late-night drive to catch up and listen to music.
sentences.zh: 进行一次深夜驾车兜风，叙叙旧并听听音乐。

sentences.en: Penny was surprised to discover Caleb was home and in bed.
sentences.zh: 佩妮惊讶地发现迦勒在家并且已经睡下了。

sentences.en: Caleb explained the trio had called it a night just after 11pm, and then they went their separate ways.
sentences.zh: 迦勒解释说，三人刚过晚上11点就结束了聚会，然后各自回家了。

sentences.en: Caleb had no idea where Tom went after this encounter, but insisted he was fine when they parted company.
sentences.zh: 迦勒根本不知道汤姆在这次见面后去了哪里，但坚称他们分开时汤姆状态很好。

sentences.en: Penny then called the other person out with Tom that night, Christian Webb.
sentences.zh: 佩妮随后打电话给那天晚上和汤姆在一起的另一个人——克里斯蒂安·韦布。

sentences.en: Christian thought it was strange Tom wasn't home.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂安觉得汤姆没回家这事很奇怪。

sentences.en: She considered he may have stayed out to drive around town by himself, or that he may have gotten a flat tyre and was stuck somewhere.
sentences.zh: 她琢磨着，汤姆可能是留在外面独自开车兜风了，或者可能是爆胎了被困在某个地方。

sentences.en: Both Caleb and Christian went out to help search for Tom.
sentences.zh: 迦勒和克里斯蒂安都出门帮忙寻找汤姆。

sentences.en: But they had no luck either.
sentences.zh: 但他们也没有好运气。

sentences.en: Tom had vanished.
sentences.zh: 汤姆人间蒸发了。

sentences.en: At 2am, Penny contacted the Hemphill County Sheriff's Department to report her son missing.
sentences.zh: 凌晨2点，佩妮联系了海姆菲尔德县治安官办公室，报告她的儿子失踪。

sentences.en: Hemphill County had elected a new sheriff just two months earlier.
sentences.zh: 海姆菲尔德县在两个月前刚刚选举产生了一位新治安官。

sentences.en: Nathan Lewis was a young and inexperienced sheriff, but he was raised in Canadian.
sentences.zh: 内森·刘易斯是一位年轻且缺乏经验的治安官，但他是在卡纳迪安长大的。

sentences.en: He knew the town.
sentences.zh: 他了解这座小镇。

sentences.en: There hadn't been a violent crime there for over 15 years.
sentences.zh: 这里已经有15年多没有发生过暴力犯罪了。

sentences.en: Calls from parents whose kids missed curfew were not unusual.
sentences.zh: 接到父母打来的电话，称孩子们过了宵禁时间未归，这并不罕见。

sentences.en: In each case, they'd show up alive and well.
sentences.zh: 在每种情况下，他们最后都会安然无恙地出现。

sentences.en: So when Sheriff Lewis heard Tom Brown hadn't come home, he was quick to assume Tom just lost track of time or was pushing boundaries.
sentences.zh: 因此，当刘易斯治安官听说汤姆·布朗没有回家时，他很快便认为汤姆只是忘了时间或者是在试探底线。

sentences.en: To him, the least likely scenario was foul play.
sentences.zh: 在他看来，遭到谋杀陷害是最不可能发生的情况。

sentences.en: Tom was described as well-liked and popular.
sentences.zh: 汤姆被形容为人缘好且受欢迎。

sentences.en: Someone with many friends from different circles.
sentences.zh: 是一个在不同圈子里都有很多朋友的人。

sentences.en: Caleb King knew Tom as a funny guy with a positive vibe who aimed to please.
sentences.zh: 迦勒·キング认识的汤姆是一个有趣、充满正能量且渴望取悦他人的人。

sentences.en: He couldn't think of a single person who didn't like him.
sentences.zh: 他想不出有哪个人不喜欢他。

sentences.en: Tom had twice been elected class president, and he had just placed 10th in the state for public speaking.
sentences.zh: 汤姆曾两次当选班长，并且刚刚在全州的公共演讲比赛中获得第十名。

sentences.en: Up until a month before his disappearance, he played for the Wildcats, Canadian high school's football team.
sentences.zh: 就在他失踪前的一个月，他还在卡纳迪安高中野猫队效力，打橄榄球。

sentences.en: With him, they'd won two state championships, which was a big deal.
sentences.zh: 有他在，他们赢得了两次州冠军，这可是件大事。

sentences.en: In Texas, high school football is more like a religion.
sentences.zh: 在得克萨斯州，高中橄榄球更像是一种宗教。

sentences.en: Kids can shoulder the weight of a community's expectations.
sentences.zh: 孩子们能够承载整个社区期望的重压。

sentences.en: To his family, Tom was just a regular kid.
sentences.zh: 对他的家人来说，汤姆只是个普通的孩子。

sentences.en: He loved WWE wrestling and idolised Tom Brady, the New England Patriots quarterback.
sentences.zh: 他热爱WWE摔角，并将新英格兰爱国者队的传奇四分卫汤姆·布雷迪视为偶像。

sentences.en: At 6 feet tall and 195 pounds, Tom appeared big enough to hold his own in a fight.
sentences.zh: 他身高6英尺，体重195磅，看起来足够健壮，能在打架时保护自己。

sentences.en: But he was far from the type to seek violence.
sentences.zh: 但他绝不是那种喜欢寻衅滋生暴力的人。

sentences.en: He had no interest in drugs or dangerous activities.
sentences.zh: 他对毒品或危险活动毫无兴趣。

sentences.en: There was no secret double life.
sentences.zh: 没有什么秘密的双重生活。

sentences.en: So when Tom didn't come home, his family couldn't shake the feeling that something was seriously wrong.
sentences.zh: 因此，当汤姆没有回家时，他的家人挥之不去地感到有什么严重的事情发生了。

sentences.en: The last known sighting of Tom was by his friends,
sentences.zh: 人们最后一次看到汤姆是在他失踪当晚，即11月23日，由他的朋友们……

sentences.en: Caleb King and Christian Webb, on the night of his disappearance, November 23rd.
sentences.zh: 迦勒·金和克里斯蒂安·韦布看到的。

sentences.en: They confirmed Tom arrived to their meet-up point, the parking lot of Canadian Middle School.
sentences.zh: 他们证实汤姆准时到达了约定地点——卡纳迪安初中的停车场。

sentences.en: Parking lot security footage filmed Tom arriving in his SUV.
sentences.zh: 停车场监控录像拍下了汤姆驾驶SUV到达的画面。

sentences.en: Caleb and Christian turned up in their own cars.
sentences.zh: 迦勒和克里斯蒂安开着各自的车随后赶到。

sentences.en: After greeting one another, they all got into Christian's car.
sentences.zh: 互相打过招呼后，他们都上了克里斯蒂安的车。

sentences.en: She drove, with Tom riding shotgun in the front seat.
sentences.zh: 她开车，汤姆坐在前排副驾驶座上。

sentences.en: Caleb was in the back.
sentences.zh: 迦勒坐在后排。

sentences.en: Both Caleb and Christian later stated they were all in good spirits.
sentences.zh: 迦勒和克里斯蒂安事后都表示，大家当时情绪都很好。

sentences.en: Tom chose the music.
sentences.zh: 音乐由汤姆挑选。

sentences.en: American folk band, the Avett Brothers.
sentences.zh: 美国民谣乐队——阿维特兄弟。

sentences.en: They drove around town, then headed north towards the Old Wagon Bridge, a near-kilometre-long footbridge over the Canadian River.
sentences.zh: 他们在镇上兜风，然后向北驶向旧马车桥，这是一座横跨卡纳迪安河、长近一公里的步行桥。

sentences.en: After parking at the southern end, they walked across together.
sentences.zh: 把车停在南端后，他们一起步行走了过去。

sentences.en: It was a cold, fall night.
sentences.zh: 那是一个寒冷的秋夜。

sentences.en: Tom was hunched up in his black windbreaker.
sentences.zh: 汤姆缩着身子穿一件黑色的风衣。

sentences.en: Emblazoned on the left of his chest were the orange letters of the Oklahoma State College football team, the Cowboys.
sentences.zh: 他的左胸前醒目地印着俄克拉荷马州立大学橄榄球队“牛仔队”的橙色字母。

sentences.en: Shortly after 11pm, the trio decided to call it a night.
sentences.zh: 晚上11点刚过，三人决定结束当晚的行程。

sentences.en: Canadian Middle School security cameras filmed Christian's car pulling into the parking lot.
sentences.zh: 卡纳迪安初中的监控摄像头拍下了克里斯蒂安的车驶入停车场的画面。

sentences.en: Caleb and Tom climbed out and returned to their own vehicles.
sentences.zh: 迦勒和汤姆下了车，回到各自的汽车上。

sentences.en: The three made plans to meet up again the next night.
sentences.zh: 三人计划第二天晚上再次见面。

sentences.en: Before they went their separate ways,
sentences.zh: 在各自道别之前，

sentences.en: Tom cheerfully told his friends,
sentences.zh: 汤姆愉快地对朋友们说：

sentences.en: I'll see you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: “我们明天见。”

sentences.en: Security footage confirmed no one had entered or tampered with Tom's car whilst it was in the school parking lot.
sentences.zh: 监控录像证实，在汤姆的车停在学校停车场期间，没有人进入或动过他的车。

sentences.en: Caleb and Christian maintained it was an uneventful night out.
sentences.zh: 迦勒和克里斯蒂安坚称这是一次平淡无奇的夜间外出。

sentences.en: Tom didn't seem anxious, upset, or distracted.
sentences.zh: 汤姆看起来并不焦虑、沮丧或心神不宁。

sentences.en: His eagerness to see them again implied he didn't plan on going anywhere anytime soon.
sentences.zh: 他急切地想再次见到他们，暗示他近期并没有去任何地方的打算。

sentences.en: Security footage showed Tom leaving the middle school car park alone in his vehicle at 11.26pm.
sentences.zh: 监控录像显示，汤姆于晚上11点26分独自驾驶汽车离开了初中停车场。

sentences.en: As Thanksgiving celebrations kicked off the following morning,
sentences.zh: 次日早晨，随着感恩节庆祝活动的拉开帷幕，

sentences.en: Tom Brown was still missing.
sentences.zh: 汤姆·布朗依然失踪不见。

sentences.en: Wanting to survey a greater area,
sentences.zh: 为了勘测更大的区域，

sentences.en: Christian Webb and her father Trey took the search to air, in Trey's helicopter.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂安·韦布和她的父亲特雷乘坐特雷的直升机展开了空中搜寻。

sentences.en: They swept over the Canadian River and its surrounding valleys.
sentences.zh: 他们飞越了卡纳迪安河及其周边的山谷。

sentences.en: Then they flew further outwards, over the panhandle's trademarked dry, empty plains.
sentences.zh: 然后他们飞得更远，越过了狭长地带标志性的干旱空旷平原。

sentences.en: A land of tumbleweeds, rusted windmills, and mechanical pump jacks drawing oil from the cracked earth.
sentences.zh: 那是一片长满风滚草、生锈的风车以及从龟裂大地下抽取石油的机械抽油机的土地。

sentences.en: Tom's car would be easily spotted out there.
sentences.zh: 汤姆的车在那里很容易被发现。

sentences.en: But they didn't find it.
sentences.zh: 但他们没有找到。

sentences.en: Tom's SUV wasn't in the town centre or stranded along US Highway Route 60 or 83.
sentences.zh: 汤姆的SUV不在市中心，也没有抛锚在美国道60号或83号公路沿线。

sentences.en: There were no sightings along the train tracks on the western edge of town.
sentences.zh: 镇西边缘的铁路线沿线也没有目击记录。

sentences.en: Christian and her father then flew 14 miles east and circled Lake Marvin.
sentences.zh: 随后，克里斯蒂安和她的父亲向东飞行了14英里，盘旋在马文湖上空。

sentences.en: The 63-acre lake was a popular area for camping, picnicking, fishing, hiking, and hunting.
sentences.zh: 这个占地63英亩的湖泊是露营、野餐、钓鱼、徒步和打猎的热门去处。

sentences.en: Tom sometimes visited the lake with friends.
sentences.zh: 汤姆有时会和朋友一起去湖边。

sentences.en: But they failed to find his car there either.
sentences.zh: 但他们在那儿也没有找到他的车。

sentences.en: They flew back towards town, over the baseball fields and rodeo grounds on Canadian's eastern edge.
sentences.zh: 他们飞回镇上，飞越了卡纳迪安东缘的棒球场和竞技场上空。

sentences.en: Then something caught Christian's eye.
sentences.zh: 这时有什么东西吸引了克里斯蒂安的注意。

sentences.en: Below, on a dirt, dead-end trail surrounded by brush and bracken,
sentences.zh: 在下方一条被灌木丛和蕨类植物包围的泥泞死胡同小路上，

sentences.en: Christian spotted a familiar red SUV.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂安发现了一辆熟悉的红色SUV。

sentences.en: A dark thought immediately crossed her mind.
sentences.zh: 一个阴暗的念头顿时掠过她的脑海。

sentences.en: Christian knew Tom had a sombre sight he hid from others.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂安知道汤姆有一个隐藏在他人背后的阴暗面。

sentences.en: At times, he had trouble picturing the future and seeing the light at the end of the tunnel.
sentences.zh: 有时，他很难想象未来，也看不到隧道尽头的曙光。

sentences.en: Had he driven to this isolated area to take his own life?
sentences.zh: 他是开车来到这个偏僻的地方寻短见的吗？

sentences.en: Christian became distraught.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂安变得心烦意乱。

sentences.en: Trey turned to the helicopter so his daughter wouldn't see inside the vehicle and carefully manoeuvred to give himself a clearer view through the windshield.
sentences.zh: 特雷把直升机转向一边，好让女儿看不到车内，并小心翼翼地操纵机身，以便通过挡风玻璃获得更清晰的视野。

sentences.en: To his relief, car was empty.
sentences.zh: 令他宽慰的是，车里是空的。

sentences.en: The Webbs notified Hemphill County Sheriff's Department of their discovery.
sentences.zh: 韦布父女将他们的发现通知了海姆菲尔德县治安官办公室。

sentences.en: Tom's car was unlocked with a window rolled halfway down.
sentences.zh: 汤姆的车没有锁，其中一扇车窗摇下一半。

sentences.en: His car keys, cell phone, wallet, and backpack, which held a school-issued laptop, were all missing.
sentences.zh: 他的车钥匙、手机、钱包以及装着学校配发笔记本电脑的双肩包全都不见了。

sentences.en: There were no visible tracks leading to or from the car.
sentences.zh: 车周围没有留下通往或离开的可辨认车辙。

sentences.en: Police conducted a rudimentary search of the vehicle.
sentences.zh: 警方对车辆进行了初步搜查。

sentences.en: On the inside driver's door handle, they found blood.
sentences.zh: 在内部驾驶员车门把手上，他们发现了血迹。

sentences.en: Tests later confirmed it was Tom's.
sentences.zh: 经检测，后证实是汤姆的血。

sentences.en: Sheriff Lewis described the bloodstain.
sentences.zh: 刘易斯治安官描述了这处血迹。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: “原话是：

sentences.en: The blood looked like you swiped your hand on the door from a small cut.
sentences.zh: 血迹看起来像是你手上有个小伤口，然后在车门上抹了一下。

sentences.en: It was not substantial.
sentences.zh: 量并不大。

sentences.en: It was not spatter or droppings, or anything indicative of an assault.
sentences.zh: 既不是血溅，也不是滴落，更没有任何迹象表明发生过袭击。”

sentences.en: On the floor of Tom's vehicle, they found a .25-caliber shell casing.
sentences.zh: 在汤姆的车内地板上，他们发现了一个.25口径的弹壳。

sentences.en: Small and easy to conceal, a .25-caliber gun is sometimes called a pocket pistol.
sentences.zh: 小巧且易于隐蔽，.25口径手枪有时被称为袖珍手枪。

sentences.en: Although not very powerful, that can still cause fatal injuries.
sentences.zh: 虽然威力不大，但仍然可能造成致命伤。

sentences.en: The shell was minus a projectile, meaning it had been fired.
sentences.zh: 弹壳里没有弹头，意味着它已经被发射过了。

sentences.en: Tom didn't own a gun and had no interest in them.
sentences.zh: 汤姆没有枪，也对枪支不感兴趣。

sentences.en: Some friends of his were gun hobbyists, which isn't unusual in rural Texas, but none owned a gun of that type that anyone knew of.
sentences.zh: 他的几个朋友是枪械爱好者，这在德克萨斯州农村并不罕见，但据所有人所知，没有谁拥有那种类型的枪。

sentences.en: A receipt for a full tank of gas was also found.
sentences.zh: 还找到了一张加满油的收据。

sentences.en: This correlated with transaction records from Penny's debit card.
sentences.zh: 这与彭妮借记卡的交易记录相吻合。

sentences.en: At 11.28pm, the night of Tom's disappearance,
sentences.zh: 在汤姆失踪当晚11点28分，

sentences.en: Penny's card was used at the Frank Oil gas station.
sentences.zh: 彭妮的卡在弗兰克石油加油站被使用了。

sentences.en: Tom often used his mother's debit card to buy fuel from there.
sentences.zh: 汤姆经常用他母亲的借记卡去那里买油。

sentences.en: Frank Oil is located on 2nd Street, less than five minutes from his home.
sentences.zh: 弗兰克石油加油站位于第二街，离他家不到五分钟路程。

sentences.en: Penny's card hadn't been used since this transaction.
sentences.zh: 自这次交易以来，彭妮的卡就再没有被使用过。

sentences.en: Frank Oil was a self-service gas station.
sentences.zh: 弗兰克石油加油站是一个自助加油站。

sentences.en: No staff were on duty.
sentences.zh: 没有员工值班。

sentences.en: Security cameras were set up, but none were working at the time.
sentences.zh: 安装了监控摄像头，但当时没有一个在工作。

sentences.en: Footage from a neighbouring business captured Tom at Frank Oil.
sentences.zh: 附近一家企业的监控录像拍到了汤姆在弗兰克石油加油站的画面。

sentences.en: Furthermore, someone driving past witnessed Tom filling up his car, but didn't see anyone else around.
sentences.zh: 此外，一名开车经过的目击者看到汤姆在给汽车加油，但没有看到周围有其他人。

sentences.en: It was around a five-minute, one-and-a-half-mile drive northeast from Frank Oil to where Tom's car was later found.
sentences.zh: 从弗兰克石油加油站到后来发现汤姆汽车的地方，大约是向东北方向行驶五分钟、一英里半的距离。

sentences.en: However, four-and-a-half gallons of fuel had been used.
sentences.zh: 然而，车里已经消耗了四加仑半的燃油。

sentences.en: This meant, in the hours between Tom filling up the tank and the discovery of his car, it was driven around 40 to 45 miles.
sentences.zh: 这意味着，在汤姆加满油到发现他的汽车这几个小时之间，车子被开着行驶了大约40到45英里。

sentences.en: Sheriff Lewis called Tom's family to report his SUV had been found.
sentences.zh: 刘易斯警长给汤姆的家人打电话，通报了其SUV被找到的消息。

sentences.en: It was on a secluded dirt trail leading to the water treatment facility on the town's north-eastern fringe.
sentences.zh: 它停在通往镇东北边缘水处理厂的一条偏僻泥土小路上。

sentences.en: It was an isolated spot that not everyone in town was familiar with.
sentences.zh: 那是一个偏僻的地方，镇上并不是每个人都熟悉。

sentences.en: According to Tom's family, they didn't believe he had ever been there before.
sentences.zh: 据汤姆的家人称，他们认为他以前从未去过那里。

sentences.en: Near Tom's car was a small incline leading to the rear of the Oasis Cove residential apartments, which were about 500 yards, or 450 metres away.
sentences.zh: 汤姆的汽车附近有一个小斜坡，通往约500码或450米外的绿洲湾居民公寓后方。

sentences.en: Although there was no evidence yet to prove it,
sentences.zh: 尽管目前还没有证据证明这一点，

sentences.en: Sheriff Lewis said he was treating the case as suicide.
sentences.zh: 刘易斯警长表示，他正将此案作为自杀来处理。

sentences.en: This only confused Tom's family.
sentences.zh: 这只让汤姆的家人感到困惑。

sentences.en: They had seen no signs of suicidal thought or action in Tom's behaviour in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 他们过去在汤姆的行为中没有看到任何自杀想法或行为的迹象。

sentences.en: Although he could be deep and retrospective, he looked forward with purpose.
sentences.zh: 尽管他有时会深沉而内省，但他对未来充满目标。

sentences.en: Tom was excited for theatre rehearsals, graduation the following year, and planned to funnel his sporting passion and public speaking skills into a career in sports journalism.
sentences.zh: 汤姆对戏剧排练、第二年的毕业充满了兴奋，并计划将他的运动热情和公开演讲技巧转化为体育新闻领域的事业。

sentences.en: Tom had also organised to see Caleb and Christian again Thanksgiving night.
sentences.zh: 汤姆还安排在感恩节当晚再次与卡勒布和克里斯蒂安见面。

sentences.en: When Tom's family looked back at his behaviour leading up to his disappearance, there were no overt or subtle signs he was contemplating an end.
sentences.zh: 当汤姆的家人回顾他失踪前的行为时，没有任何明显或微妙的迹象表明他在考虑结束生命。

sentences.en: Tom did have personal struggles, though.
sentences.zh: 不过，汤姆确实有个人的挣扎。

sentences.en: His parents divorced when he was eight years old, and only recently Tom had spoken candidly about the divorce to friends, admitting his religious faith was shaken as a result.
sentences.zh: 在他八岁时父母就离异了，直到最近，汤姆才向朋友们坦诚地谈起过父母的离异，并承认他的宗教信仰因此受到了动摇。

sentences.en: When Tom was 16 years old, he had a run-in with local law enforcement.
sentences.zh: 汤姆16岁时，曾与当地执法部门有过一次冲突。

sentences.en: One night, Tom was downtown with two friends when they were approached by a deputy.
sentences.zh: 一天晚上，汤姆和两个朋友在市中心时，一名副警长走近了他们。

sentences.en: He accused the group of trying to break into a building on Main Street.
sentences.zh: 他指控这群人试图闯入主街上的一栋建筑。

sentences.en: The boys strongly denied the accusation.
sentences.zh: 男孩们强烈否认这一指控。

sentences.en: This was the first and only time Tom had an encounter with police.
sentences.zh: 这是汤姆第一次也是唯一一次与警察遭遇。

sentences.en: He was told to call his mother, but Tom refused, stating he hadn't done anything and didn't know what he was supposed to say.
sentences.zh: 他被告知给母亲打电话，但汤姆拒绝了，称自己什么也没做，也不知道该说些什么。

sentences.en: Tom was ordered into the deputy's car.
sentences.zh: 汤姆被命令坐进副警长的车里。

sentences.en: He complied, but nothing ever came of this accusation, and Tom was free to go.
sentences.zh: 他照做了，但这个指控最终不了了之，汤姆获准离开。

sentences.en: According to Tom's mother, Penny, the deputy who dealt with Tom and his friends that night was Nathan Lewis, prior to his appointment as sheriff for Hemphill County.
sentences.zh: 据汤姆的母亲彭妮所说，那天晚上处理汤姆及其朋友事务的副警长是内森·刘易斯，当时他尚未被任命为汉普希尔县的警长。

sentences.en: Then, only a month before his disappearance,
sentences.zh: 然后，就在他失踪前的一个月，

sentences.en: Tom quit the high school football team.
sentences.zh: 汤姆退出了高中橄榄球队。

sentences.en: Despite being seen as a dedicated and talented player, the coach replaced him as a starter.
sentences.zh: 尽管被视为一名敬业且有天赋的球员，教练还是取消了他首发队员的资格。

sentences.en: Tom was now a reserve.
sentences.zh: 汤姆现在成了一名替补。

sentences.en: Training almost every day, sometimes twice a day, to spend games on the bench, he quickly lost intereSt.
sentences.zh: 几乎每天都在训练，有时一天训练两次，却只能在比赛时枯坐替补席，他很快就失去了兴趣。

sentences.en: It was a difficult week when Tom quit, but people were understanding.
sentences.zh: 汤姆退队的那周很艰难，但大家都表示理解。

sentences.en: There was no lingering animosity over his decision.
sentences.zh: 对于他的决定，并没有残留的敌意。

sentences.en: Only ten days before his disappearance,
sentences.zh: 就在他失踪前十天，

sentences.en: Tom and his girlfriend,
sentences.zh: 汤姆和他的女朋友

sentences.en: Sage Pennington, broke up.
sentences.zh: 萨奇·彭宁顿分手了。

sentences.en: Sage was a freshman at West Texas A&M University in Canyon, two hours away from Canadian.
sentences.zh: 萨奇是位于卡耐基两小时车程外的卡尼昂市西德克萨斯农工大学的一名大一新生。

sentences.en: The reason for the split is unknown, but according to Tom's mother, it was amicable.
sentences.zh: 分手的原因不得而知，但据汤姆的母亲说，这是和平分手的。

sentences.en: The pair remained friends, and they still messaged each other.
sentences.zh: 两人保持着朋友关系，并且仍然互相发信息。

sentences.en: Sage was back home in Canadian for the Thanksgiving break.
sentences.zh: 萨奇为了感恩节假期回到了加拿大的家中。

sentences.en: Records show Tom sent her a text message around 11.30pm the night of his disappearance.
sentences.zh: 记录显示，汤姆在失踪当晚11点30分左右给她发送了一条短信。

sentences.en: What was said is not publicly known, but according to those who've read it, it was a casual, how are you doing, type message.
sentences.zh: 具体内容不得而知，但据读过的人说，那是一条随意的、类似于“你最近怎么样”的信息。

sentences.en: Sage responded.
sentences.zh: 萨奇回复了。

sentences.en: Her text was delivered.
sentences.zh: 她的短信已送达。

sentences.en: But Tom never replied.
sentences.zh: 但汤姆再也没有回复。

sentences.en: The Texas Parks and Wildlife Department supplied tracking dogs to investigate Tom's car.
sentences.zh: 得克萨斯州公园和野生动物部门提供搜救犬来调查汤姆的汽车。

sentences.en: Scanning a radius almost half a mile around it, the dogs failed to pick up a scent.
sentences.zh: 经过对车周围近半英里半径的搜寻，警犬未能捕捉到气味。

sentences.en: They followed a trail leading east from Tom's car, but it didn't go far, ending at some nearby brush.
sentences.zh: 它们顺着一条从汤姆车向东延伸的路线追踪，但没走多远就在附近的一些灌木丛处结束了。

sentences.en: The next day, a second set of highly trained and experienced tracking dogs were sent from the nearby city of Amarillo.
sentences.zh: 第二天，第二支训练有素、经验丰富的搜救犬队伍从附近的阿马里洛市被派了过来。

sentences.en: These dogs picked up a scent in Tom's car, leading handlers nearly a mile east before reaching the Canadian River.
sentences.zh: 这些搜救犬在汤姆的车里捕捉到了气味，带领训导员向东走了近一英里，直到到达加拿大河。

sentences.en: It was along the marshy banks of the shallow and slow-moving waters where they lost the scent.
sentences.zh: 正是在这片浅而水流缓慢的河水长满沼泽的岸边，它们失去了气味。

sentences.en: It was inconclusive whether the dogs were following Tom's scent specifically or someone else who may have been in the vehicle.
sentences.zh: 目前尚无定论这些搜救犬追踪的究竟是汤姆的气味，还是车里可能呆过的其他人的气味。

sentences.en: Tips to law enforcement led to the search for Tom extending to neighbouring towns and counties.
sentences.zh: 根据提供给执法部门的线索，对汤姆的搜寻扩大到了邻近的城镇和县。

sentences.en: Tom's social media accounts, bank and cell phone records were checked for activity.
sentences.zh: 汤姆的社交媒体账号、银行和手机记录都接受了活动检查。

sentences.en: None had been accessed since his disappearance.
sentences.zh: 自从他失踪以来，这些都没有被访问过。

sentences.en: His cell phone was still off and going to voicemail, although they were able to trace the last known location of Tom's phone before it was turned off.
sentences.zh: 他的手机仍然处于关机状态并转入语音信箱，不过他们能够追踪到汤姆手机关机前的最后已知位置。

sentences.en: Shortly after midnight,
sentences.zh: 午夜刚过不久，

sentences.en: November 24th,
Tom's phone emitted a ping indicating it was at the Wildcats football stadium.
sentences.zh: 汤姆的手机发出了一个信号，表明它在野猫橄榄球场。

sentences.en: The stadium is near the southeastern border of town, just over a mile from Franc Oil, where Tom was last seen filling up.
sentences.zh: 该体育场位于镇东南边界附近，距离汤姆最后一次被看到加油的弗兰克石油加油站刚过一英里。

sentences.en: No motive has been established for Tom to have gone to the stadium at this time.
sentences.zh: 目前尚未确定汤姆此时前往体育场的动机。

sentences.en: With this knowledge, law enforcement pieced together
sentences.zh: 凭借这些已知信息，执法部门拼凑出了

sentences.en: Tom's last movements.
sentences.zh: 汤姆最后的行动轨迹。

sentences.en: At 11.26pm,
sentences.zh: 晚上11点26分，

sentences.en: Tom was captured on footage leaving the Canadian
sentences.zh: 监控拍到汤姆独自一人离开加拿大

sentences.en: Middle School car park, alone.
sentences.zh: 中学的停车场。

sentences.en: He went directly to Franc Oil to purchase a tank of gas at 11.28pm.
sentences.zh: 他于晚上11点28分径直前往弗兰克石油加油站加了一箱油。

sentences.en: Shortly after midnight, his phone pinged indicating it was at the Wildcats football stadium.
sentences.zh: 午夜过后不久，他的手机发出信号，显示其位于野猫橄榄球场。

sentences.en: Soon after this final ping,
sentences.zh: 在这个最后信号发出后不久，

sentences.en: Tom's phone was switched off.
sentences.zh: 汤姆的手机被关机了。

sentences.en: Shortly after daybreak, his car was located on the dirt trail near the water treatment facility.
sentences.zh: 破晓后不久，他的汽车在水处理厂附近的泥土小路上被找到。

sentences.en: These sequence of events only became more difficult to decipher when law enforcement began collating the town's security footage the night of Tom's disappearance.
sentences.zh: 当执法部门开始整理汤姆失踪当晚全镇的监控录像时，这一系列事件变得更加难以琢磨。

sentences.en: A camera on the corner of 2nd Street and Main caught a red SUV quickly pass by around 1.30am.
sentences.zh: 第二街和主街转角处的一个摄像头拍到一辆红色的SUV在凌晨1点30分左右快速驶过。

sentences.en: The car matched Tom's.
sentences.zh: 这辆车与汤姆的车相符。

sentences.en: This sighting occurred close to 90 minutes after that final phone ping at the football stadium.
sentences.zh: 这次目击发生在橄榄球场最后一次手机信号发出后将近90分钟。

sentences.en: Nine minutes later,
sentences.zh: 九分钟后，

sentences.en: Tucker Brown's car appeared on the same camera.
sentences.zh: 塔克·布朗的车出现在同一个摄像头画面中。

sentences.en: This was during the time he was out searching for Tom.
sentences.zh: 当时他正外出寻找汤姆。

sentences.en: Tucker didn't know he was following his brother's SUV just minutes behind, and the two cars never crossed paths.
sentences.zh: 塔克不知道自己只落后几分钟在追踪他兄弟的SUV，两辆车从未相遇。

sentences.en: Tom's car reappeared on security footage at 5.24am, travelling north on 2nd Street.
sentences.zh: 汤姆的汽车在凌晨5点24分的监控录像中再次出现，当时正向北行驶在第二街上。

sentences.en: For the next 20 minutes, the vehicle seemed to be driving directionless all over town.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的20分钟里，这辆车似乎在全镇漫无目的地乱开。

sentences.en: At times, it appeared to be heading towards Tom's house, but turned away when it got close.
sentences.zh: 有时，它似乎正朝汤姆的家开去，但靠近时又调转了方向。

sentences.en: Eventually, the SUV headed northeast towards the water treatment facility.
sentences.zh: 最终，这辆SUV向东北方向驶向水处理厂。

sentences.en: Footage captured the vehicle driving past the Hemphill County
sentences.zh: 监控拍到这辆车驶过了位于第六街的汉普希尔县

sentences.en: Recreation Complex on 6th Street.
sentences.zh: 娱乐综合体。

sentences.en: The car then moved off camera, continuing east onto an isolated dirt track towards the water treatment facility.
sentences.zh: 随后汽车驶出监控范围，继续向东驶上一条通往水处理厂的偏僻土路，

sentences.en: where it was later found abandoned.
sentences.zh: 它后来在那里被发现遗弃。

sentences.en: No footage was clear enough to identify the SUV's driver, or to determine if there was more than one occupant.
sentences.zh: 没有任何录像足够清晰来辨认SUV的驾驶员，或者确定车内是否不止一名乘客。

sentences.en: Nevertheless,
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，

sentences.en: Sheriff Lewis felt confident
sentences.zh: 刘易斯警长确信

sentences.en: Tom was driving, alone.
sentences.zh: 当时是汤姆独自一人在开车。

sentences.en: It didn't make sense to him that someone who had harmed Tom would then get into his car and drive all over town.
sentences.zh: 在他看来，伤害汤姆的人接着又开着他的车满镇子乱晃，这在逻辑上说不通。

sentences.en: In the following days,
sentences.zh: 在随后的几天里，

sentences.en: Sheriff Lewis enlisted other law enforcement agencies, fire departments, and local townspeople to help find
sentences.zh: 刘易斯警长征召了其他执法部门、消防部门和当地镇民来协助寻找

sentences.en: Tom Brown.
sentences.zh: 汤姆·布朗。

sentences.en: The area where
sentences.zh: 发现

sentences.en: Tom's vehicle was discovered, the nearby water treatment facility, and the Canadian River were scoured on foot, horseback,
